map.OCT(RNFL厚度)青光眼评估器 使用指南: OCT (RNFL Thickness) Glaucoma Evaluator User Guide
map.输入 RNFL 全局及四象限厚度(μm)与年龄，对比正常数据库并校验 ISNT: Enter global and four-quadrant RNFL thickness (um) with age, compare against a normal database and check the ISNT rule.
map.按年龄校正各象限 RNFL 厚度期望值并判读。: Correct the expected RNFL thickness per quadrant by age before interpretation.
map.ISNT 节律（下>上>鼻>颞）符合性检查。: ISNT rhythm check (inferior > superior > nasal > temporal).
map.：期望 G=100−(60−50)×0.2=98、S/I120、N70、T60；: Expected G=100-(60-50)x0.2=98, S/I120, N70, T60; the measurements broadly agree and ISNT holds, so the RNFL is essentially normal.
map.上方显著变薄: The superior quadrant is significantly thinner
map.：若 S 降至 80、违反 ISNT，提示上方象限缺损，警惕青光眼。: If S drops to 80 and ISNT is violated, it points to a superior quadrant defect, so watch for glaucoma.
map.RNFL 随龄变薄（约 0.2μm/年），校正后判读更准。: RNFL thins with age (about 0.2 um per year), so correcting before interpretation is more accurate.
map.ISNT 违反一定患病？: Does violating ISNT mean you have the disease?
map.是重要征象但不绝对，须结合杯盘比与视野。: It is an important sign but not absolute; combine it with the cup-to-disc ratio and the visual field.
